portrait.reason: Closest match to the original goggled driver, clear three-quarter silhouette, transparent edges, and enough facial room for portrait animation.

pickupPedestal.reason: The simplest compact pad has the clearest empty center for deterministic item-icon overlays. More detailed alternatives remain available for depots and rare pickups.

industrialHazards.reason: The request did not produce seamless opaque terrain. It did produce coherent transparent refinery hazards and pipe props, so those outputs are retained only for those roles.

basaltTerrain.reason: None of the outputs is a seamless, opaque, edge-matched floor tile. The Tilemap Editor autotile workflow must own terrain-edge grammar instead.
